headline: Keep privacy verification complete at current inventory size

items.title: Preserve complete privacy scanning beyond the default process buffer
items.insight: Native source step128 failed both privacy assertions with git ENOBUFS; the full ls-files output exceeds1MiB. The scanner never reached matching, rather than finding forbidden public content. Visitors retain the same privacy protection while maintainers can verify the full source inventory.
items.evidence: Both actual privacy assertions pass on the unchanged full inventory, measured >1MiB. No scan path, privacy token, exclusion, assertion or TODO policy changes. Larger-than16MiB remains fail-closed; independent review passes.
